commits.subject: Fix login redirect: SameSite=Lax session cookie

patches.088c9ceddb42e01f7713a44e7077f05eedaa8cf9:
diff --git a/src/lib/auth/cookies.ts b/src/lib/auth/cookies.ts
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/src/lib/auth/cookies.ts
+++ b/src/lib/auth/cookies.ts
@@ -8,9 +8,10 @@ export function setSessionCookie(token: string) {
   cookies().set(SESSION_COOKIE, token, {
     httpOnly: true,
     secure: true,
-    sameSite: 'none',
-    domain: '.acme.dev',
+    // Lax keeps the cookie on the redirect back from the identity provider.
+    sameSite: 'lax',
     path: '/',
+    maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 7
   })
 }
patches.009c48c2e7510515b05a75baff8cbf63c4056f93:
diff --git a/src/lib/auth/cookies.test.ts b/src/lib/auth/cookies.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1111111
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/lib/auth/cookies.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { setSessionCookie } from './cookies'
+
+describe('setSessionCookie', () => {
+  it('uses SameSite=Lax so the redirect keeps the session', () => {
+    const set = vi.fn()
+    vi.mock('next/headers', () => ({ cookies: () => ({ set }) }))
+    setSessionCookie('t0ken')
+    expect(set).toHaveBeenCalledWith('session_token', 't0ken', expect.objectContaining({ sameSite: 'lax' }))
+  })
+})
